name: typing-animation

frames.best_why: A complete phrase is typed out with the cursor bar at the end, showing the settled state.

tagline: Words type out letter by letter behind a blinking bar.
summary: A line of bold text that types itself out one character at a time with a small blinking cursor, pauses, deletes, and moves on to the next phrase in a loop.
appearance: Large, heavy white letters sit on a black field, ending in a thin vertical bar cursor. A half-typed line leaves a lot of empty space to its right, and the text starts from the left.
behaviour: Characters appear one after another at a steady pace with the cursor blinking at the end, then the line is erased the same way and the next phrase begins. It replays forever.
demo_content: The phrases Build faster, Ship smarter and Design better typing in turn.
search_phrases: text typing itself on a page
use_when: A hero or heading should cycle through a few short phrases with a typewriter feel.
avoid_when: Important copy; the text is repeatedly deleted and hard to catch while typing.
customise: Pass words as an array or a single string child, and tune duration, typeSpeed, deleteSpeed, delay, pauseDelay, loop, cursorStyle and cursor visibility; the tag is chosen with as.
weight_why: A chain of timeouts updates a short string; there is no continuous frame loop.

a11y.note: The changing text has no live region, so screen readers may not announce it, and reduced-motion is never checked.

polish_why: Clean typewriter with a tidy blinking cursor, but it is a very common effect with default styling.
title: Typing Animation
